name: Default
shortDescription: OneUptime monitoring and observability platform with uptime probes, status pages, incidents, on-call and telemetry, backed by PostgreSQL, ClickHouse and Valkey.

alerts.message: The first account that signs up becomes the master admin. Anyone who can reach the domain can sign up after you, so turn off sign-ups under Settings > Authentication in the Admin Dashboard (/admin).
OneUptime sends no email until a mail server is set up in the Admin Dashboard under Settings > Notifications > Emails.
